description: Header file defining interface for tiny roaming functionality in wireless device management, including enums, callback types, and function prototypes.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_roamTo
methods.description: Initiates roaming to a specified BSSID with attempt and timeout parameters, and a callback upon completion.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_targetBssid
methods.description: Retrieves the target BSSID for roaming associated with a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_isRoaming
methods.description: Checks if the specified endpoint is currently roaming.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_init
methods.description: Initializes roaming state for the specified endpoint.

methods.name: wld_tinyRoam_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up roaming resources for the specified endpoint.
